notes.title: Update Monday! - NEW MAP!
notes.notes:
[b]Update Monday[/b] is upon us, and boy is it a BIG one!
[b]New Map - Arena:[/b] No holds-barred battle in a warehouse to get the blood flowing! This makes[u] [b][i]6 Maps[/i][/b][/u] to choose from.

[b]Weapon updates:[/b] Increased sniper damage, decreased pistol damage. Improved rocket, grenade and grenade launcher damage and explosions.

OH and did I mention [b]EXPLOSIONS![/b] My friends, you would think [b][i]Michael Bay[/i][/b] had paid us a visit. 

[b]WE NOW HAVE SHRAPNEL DAMAGE! [/b]You've heard the old saying "Close enough is only good in horseshoes and hand grenades." right? Well now it's true.

And to top it all off, SC:TT is now [b]ON SALE - Save 20%[/b]

New maps, better weapons, sale.... means More for Less!

Jump in game and kill away!

notes.title: Happy Update Monday!
notes.notes:
Hi All,

Well, it's Monday again, and time to fix some bugs!

This week's update includes:

[b]Map fixes:
City Strees[/b] - minor fixes and updates

[b]Demons Run/ Dreadnaught Assault[/b] - 
Elevator update: Now the switches only work if the elevator is stopped - the toggle switch ON the platform will still work.

[b]ALSO[/b]

Ecotone found a deal on the [b][i]Robot Kyle[/i][/b] brand of bots. Keep an eye out for him.

Happy Killing!

notes.title: DirectX Update
notes.notes:
Hi All,

We are working hard to bring you the best games that we can. As part of our plans for version 1.5 we have upgraded from DX9 to DX11.

Why?
We are implementing a new FPS system in SC:TT v1.5 that will be used in  [url=http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=235945780] Second Coming: The Annakazi Invasion [/url]. This will help us better support the two games during updating cycles.

[b]Other Updates with this Patch:[/b]
 [list]
    [*]Repaired stairs in broken building on City Streets where people were getting snagged on colliders.
    [*]Aggressors spawn area on Demons Run repaired - no more damage leaving spawn.
    [*]Minor glitches and graphic fixes
[/list]

Can't wait to see everyone in server!

notes.title: New Update this afternoon
notes.notes:
We ran into some glitches in our achievement system on launch and had to revert to an older build. The bad part was that we had other improvements that had to be pulled when we reverted.

We are working on having a build ready WITH achievements for Monday, but in the meantime, we have restored many of the "lost" improvements.

[b]THE NEW BUILD WILL BE LIVE AT 4:20 EST![/b]

Please make sure to download the latest build then, and See you in game!

notes.title: Release in 7 days!
notes.notes:
SC:TT will officially be released for sale on Steam on April 30th. It is in the "Coming Soon" phase for the next week while we are still polishing the code and finding any issues resulting from our Steam integration. You'll see updating happening at an alarming rate. Don't be scared. We're fixing things.

Contributors - please check your email for your Product Key so that you can install SC:TT before release. Don't forget to take and upload screenshots to the community hub!

Now... Let's go kick some ass.
